svg.title: The graph, after each session
svg.desc: The graph Graphiti stored for the example, after session 1 and after session 2. Entities are boxes coloured by their type: person, place, preference, health condition. After session 1, seven facts all start at Anton: a dinner plan stored twice, once to Anton's sister and once to Berlin; strictly vegetarian; a peanut allergy; Indian cuisine; paneer dishes; a budget of 40 euros a head. The assistant is an entity with no facts. After session 2, the vegetarian fact is dashed, closed on 20 July, and a pescatarian diet fact starts at Anton. The assistant has a fact pointing at the pescatarian diet. Anton lives in Kreuzberg and has a sister named Lena; from Anton's sister a fact leads to Lena's partner Jonas, and from Jonas to coeliac. A second node called Lena, connected to nothing else, holds 'Lena cannot eat shellfish'.
svg.text: Every entity is a box and every fact is an arrow between two of them, named by its relation. Each entity is drawn in the
same place in both pictures, so what session 2 added stands out.
After session 1, in March: 7 facts, all starting at Anton
After session 2, in July: 14 facts, one of them closed
The closed fact is dashed, with the day it ended. The second box called Lena is a second node for the same person: step 2 did not match it to
